method.odds: Action Network, last pregame line at each book
method.weights: Current 25-question weights and market-check tuning (v2.2), applied unchanged to every week
method.data: Each week uses only box scores before that week, that week's final injury report and game-day inactives
method.live: Halftime triggers checked against the real first-half box score and halftime score. Old live prices are not archived, so the live line is estimated as first-half stat + half the pregame line; a plan only bets when that line meets its ladder, sized from the ladder and graded at that line at −115
method.caveat: Weeks 1–5 are a replay of the current model (its weights were fit on history that includes those weeks, so they are not a blind test). Week 6 onward is the real card as published before kickoff, graded against what happened.
